risk_notes: A shell command interpolates caller-controlled input.

findings.summary: User input reaches a shell command unescaped.
findings.consequence: Any caller can run arbitrary commands on the host.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass an argument list to subprocess.run without shell=True.

findings.summary: The new list_dir function has no test.
findings.consequence: A regression in list_dir would ship unnoticed.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a unit test for list_dir; use rule_id coverage.missing_test.
